class.name: SimulationRuntime
class.brief_description: The running simulation: [SimulationServer]'s clock ticks only while this node is in the tree.
class.description: The game places it in its scene explicitly. A scenery loaded without it - in the editor, in a viewer - is built, but nothing in it runs: no drivers, events or vehicle physics. In the editor the node does nothing, so a game scene opened there does not start the clock.
